# Document generation and private-chat recovery

Scope: internal-only bug fix; no version bump, release, production change, key
deletion, device recreation, or real-message sending. Test data is synthetic.

## Reproduction / RED

- Checkpoint `694ee118`: Word preflight used a different Python alias than the
  renderer; resolved FAIL ToolResults were treated as successes; empty/missing
  files could be reported as produced. Seven targeted assertions failed. A
  separate local browser test was blocked by the sandbox and passed outside it.
- The same checkpoint reproduced chat load failures displayed as empty history
  and the initial request escaping the non-overlapping poll guard (two failures).
- Checkpoint `7044e8ef`: identity conflict lacked public recovery identifiers and
  retried six times in ten seconds (two failing assertions).
- Checkpoint `fb986478`: a stale output document was mistaken for a new result.
- Checkpoint `286ab94e`: real Word rendering hit the 30-second timeout. A bounded,
  dependency-free parser probe independently reproduced a loop on `# Heading`.
  Bare hashes and incomplete table prefixes also failed to advance the cursor.

## Fix / GREEN

- Probe the resolved renderer Python via argv and the renderer environment for
  both bundled and system runtimes. Preserve failure-cache expiry and retry.
- Throw on generation failures so the existing execution engine records errors.
  Render to a fresh temporary file, check nonempty output, then copy to the
  destination. Failed generation does not reuse a previous destination as proof.
- Consume level-one headings and unknown Markdown prefixes without looping.
- Separate chat loading/errors from genuine empty history and action failures.
  Initial load, polls, and explicit reload share an in-flight guard. Keep loaded
  messages and unsent drafts on timeout. Reload never resends messages.
- Identity conflicts still fail closed. Diagnostic text contains only endpoint,
  public device ID and key fingerprint, never key material. Pause automatic
  retries until explicit reload; retain all files and anti-rollback checks.

## Verification (Windows, 2026-10-03)

Core command (from packages/core):

```text
OTTO_REAL_DOCX_SMOKE=1 npx vitest run src/tools/generate-document.test.ts src/core/nonInteractiveToolExecutor.test.ts src/services/bundledRuntime.test.ts src/core/coreToolScheduler.test.ts src/tools/generate-safe-document.test.ts src/tools/convert-document.test.ts --coverage.enabled=true --coverage.include=src/tools/generate-document.ts --coverage.include=src/core/nonInteractiveToolExecutor.ts
```

Result: **95 passed, 4 environment-conditional skips**. The real Word smoke ran:
five successive files generated by the selected system Python, with OOXML ZIP
contents and each document's body checked. Real browser PNG rendering also ran.

Desktop command (from packages/desktop):

```text
npx vitest run src/main/enterprise-crypto-migration.test.ts src/main/enterprise-e2ee.test.ts src/main/enterprise-client.test.ts src/renderer/components/OrganizationTree.test.tsx src/renderer/lib/nonOverlappingPoll.test.ts --coverage.enabled=true --coverage.include=src/renderer/components/OrganizationTree.tsx --coverage.include=src/main/enterprise-e2ee.ts
```

Result: **158 passed**. Includes conflicting identities remaining untouched,
retained old history/outbox, account isolation, rollback rejection, load retries,
and preservation of draft/history after timeout.

Core and desktop main/preload/renderer typechecks passed. Changed TypeScript
files passed ESLint. `git diff --check` and `npm run code-map:check` passed.

Coverage is scoped, not whole-application certification: core selected files
77.18% lines / 58.50% branches; desktop selected files 81.83% lines / 74.12%
branches. Historical branches in these large files remain below an 80% branch
target; no coverage thresholds were lowered.

## Remaining limits

- Repository doctor still fails the pre-existing source-size guard: 55.09 MB
  against 55 MB (55.08 MB before this change). Other doctor checks pass. No
  unrelated files were removed and no size budget was raised.
- Public health responses do not verify authenticated private-chat delivery.
  A real multi-key conflict still requires verifying the original device and
  history namespace; this change does not automatically choose or merge keys.
- This is source-level/local-engine verification, not a newly installed client
  or complete installation/upgrade/signing acceptance. Installed 1.9.18 remains
  unchanged; no new release is authorized by this change.
